name: What types of outdoor fireplaces does AKN Design Group install?

mainEntity.name: What types of outdoor fireplaces does AKN Design Group install?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group specializes in designing and building custom outdoor fireplaces that integrate seamlessly with your overall high-end outdoor living space. This includes traditional masonry fireplaces, modern gas fireplaces, and custom fire features tailored to your aesthetic and functional preferences. We focus on solutions that enhance both the beauty and utility of your outdoor environment, ensuring the fireplace becomes a central, functional element of your custom patio or outdoor kitchen area.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group installs custom masonry and gas outdoor fireplaces, designed to integrate with your high-end outdoor living space.
